title: 25-Storey Mixed-Use Tower Proposed on Plains Road in Burlington
summary: Plans have been submitted to redevelop a commercial property near Burlington GO station with a 25-storey, primarily residential mixed-use tower. Designed by WZMH Architects for Rester Management, the proposal at 1376-1382 Plains Road East calls for a condominium tower with ground-floor retail.
